name: Account Takeover and Compromised Identity Response
description: Responds to account takeover indicators such as impossible travel, new device login, MFA bypass, or credential in breach data. Validates the anomaly, revokes active sessions, resets credentials, forces MFA re-enrolment, and guides the user through account recovery.

triggers.name: Identity Alert
triggers.description: Receives account takeover signal from Azure AD Identity Protection, Okta, or SIEM

actions.name: Parse Identity Alert
actions.description: Extract user, anomaly type (impossible travel/new device/breach), source IP, location

actions.name: Check Breach Databases
actions.description: Check if the user email appears in known breach datasets

actions.name: Enrich Login IP
actions.description: Check the suspicious login IP for VPN/proxy/Tor exit node status

actions.name: Revoke All Sessions
actions.description: Immediately revoke all active user sessions across all apps

actions.name: Force Password Reset
actions.description: Force an immediate password reset on next login

actions.name: Revoke MFA Devices
actions.description: Remove all registered MFA methods to force re-enrolment with verified device

actions.name: Block Suspicious Login IP
actions.description: Add the suspicious source IP to Azure AD conditional access block list

actions.name: Notify User via Phone
actions.description: Text the user on their registered phone number to alert them and guide recovery

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: SECURITY ALERT: Your company account showed suspicious activity. Your password has been reset and sessions revoked. Contact the SOC on +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX to recover access.

actions.name: Create Account Takeover Case
actions.description: Document account takeover attempt with all evidence for IR review
